Indian heiress alleges racism in Switzerland, sparks debate

An Indian heiress, Vasundhara Oswal, has alleged experiencing racism and xenophobia during a visit to Switzerland. She shared her experience in a viral social media post, questioning the perception of Switzerland as a welcoming destination for Indians. The incident has prompted discussions about xenophobia and perceptions of India abroad.
